scrim-multiply-1.summary: scrim multiplied toward ambientColor, per-scene saturation; app 1.3+

scenes.name: Rain on a City Window
scenes.description: Rain running down a window at night, blurred city lights and neon reflections beyond the glass. Melancholy, urban, contemplative. Suits noir, modern city scenes, loneliness, insomnia and quiet introspection.
examples: She stood at the window with the lights off, watching the rain run down the glass and the traffic smear red and white below.
He pressed his forehead to the cold pane. Outside, the neon across the street bled into the wet, and nobody on the pavement looked up.

scenes.name: Desert Dunes
scenes.description: Vast sunlit sand dunes under a pale sky, heat haze on the horizon, no shelter in sight. Arid, immense, punishing. Suits desert crossings, caravans, exile, thirst, endurance and desolate journeys.
examples: By noon the sand was too hot to touch. They walked the ridge of the dune with their heads down and the horizon shaking in the heat.
There was nothing in any direction but sand and the pale sky, and the tracks behind them were already filling in.

scenes.name: Storm at Sea
scenes.description: A dark heaving ocean under a bruised sky, spray tearing off the wave crests. Violent, cold, perilous. Suits shipwrecks, whaling voyages, naval battles, sailors in danger and storms at sea.
examples: The deck dropped away under him and came back up hard. Spray came over the rail in sheets and the mast groaned against the wind.
They lashed everything down that could be lashed and watched the next wave build, black and higher than the last.

scenes.name: Candlelit Study
scenes.description: A cramped wood-panelled study at night, papers and ledgers stacked by candlelight, shutters closed. Secretive, scholarly, close. Suits investigation, correspondence, conspiracies, late-night work and Victorian interiors.
examples: He worked on by the light of one candle, the ledger open in front of him and the shutters closed against the street.
The papers had spread across the desk and onto the floor. She lit a second candle and went back to the letter.

scenes.name: Snowbound Village
scenes.description: A small village under deep snow at dusk, windows glowing faintly, smoke from chimneys, tracks in the drifts. Isolated, hushed, wintry. Suits harsh winters, remote communities, folklore and homecoming.
examples: The snow had come up to the sills overnight. Smoke went straight up from every chimney and the lane was a single set of tracks.
They stamped their boots in the doorway. Through the window the village was quiet under the snow, a few windows lit.

scenes.name: Grand Ballroom
scenes.description: A gilded ballroom lit by chandeliers, mirrors and polished floors, crowded and formal. Opulent, social, performative. Suits balls, courtship, high society, intrigue among the wealthy and period drama.
examples: The chandeliers were lit and the floor was full. She took his arm and they went in under the mirrors.
Music came up the staircase. In the ballroom the couples turned and the gilt caught the light from a hundred candles.

scenes.name: Ruined Abbey
scenes.description: Roofless stone arches overgrown with ivy, weak light through empty windows, rubble underfoot. Ancient, haunted, melancholy. Suits ruins, forgotten history, gothic dread and abandoned sacred places.
examples: They climbed through the broken arch into what had been the nave. Ivy had the walls, and the sky was where the roof should be.
He sat on a fallen block of stone among the rubble. Weak light came through the empty windows of the abbey.

scenes.name: Steam Train Carriage
scenes.description: The interior of an old railway carriage in motion, countryside sliding past the window, brass fittings and worn upholstery. Transitional, enclosed, rhythmic. Suits journeys, chance meetings, pursuit and travel between cities.
examples: The carriage swayed and the fields went past the window, green and then gold. He set his case on the rack and sat down.
She wiped the glass with her glove and watched the countryside slide by, the brass fittings rattling with every joint in the rail.

scenes.name: Battlefield at Dawn
scenes.description: An open field under low grey light, smoke drifting, banners and spears in the distance. Tense, grim, monumental. Suits armies before battle, sieges, epic conflict and the aftermath of war.
examples: At first light the field was grey and quiet. Smoke drifted low over the grass and the banners on the far ridge did not move.
They stood in their lines with the spears up, waiting. Somewhere ahead a horse screamed and then stopped.

scenes.name: Tropical Harbour
scenes.description: A busy colonial harbour in bright heat, wooden ships at anchor, crates and palms along the quay. Lively, humid, mercantile. Suits ports of call, trade, arrivals by sea and island settlements.
examples: The quay was loud with heat and men and crates. Ships rode at anchor beyond the palms, their sails furled.
He came down the gangway into the smell of tar and fruit. The harbour water was green and full of small boats.

scenes.name: Bamboo Grove in Mist
scenes.description: A dense grove of tall green bamboo in morning mist, stems creaking overhead, narrow paths of packed earth running between them. Enclosed, hushed, green-lit. Suits martial arts, hermits and sages, ambushes among the stalks, and journeys through southern China or Japan.
examples: The path went in between the bamboo and the mist closed behind them. The stems creaked overhead in a wind they could not feel.
She stopped in the grove and listened. Nothing but the bamboo knocking together and water dripping off the leaves.

scenes.name: Autumn Birch Forest
scenes.description: A stand of white-trunked birches in late autumn, the canopy turned gold and the ground deep in fallen leaves. Bright, brittle, wistful. Suits journeys on foot, partings, the turn of a season, and memories of childhood woods.
examples: The birches were white against the gold, and the leaves came down whenever the wind moved. They walked without talking.
He went in under the trees. The ground was deep in leaves and the light came through the canopy the colour of honey.

scenes.name: Mangrove Swamp at Dusk
scenes.description: Brackish water threading between tangled mangrove roots at dusk, still and thick with insects, no firm ground anywhere. Humid, claustrophobic, uneasy. Suits escapes through wetland, fevers, smuggling, and places where a body would never be found.
examples: The boat pushed in among the mangrove roots. The water was brown and still and the insects started as the light went.
They waded through the swamp with the mud pulling at their boots, roots tangled at every step and dusk coming on.

scenes.name: Red Rock Canyon
scenes.description: A deep canyon of layered red sandstone with a thin river far below, walls striped by centuries, heat coming off the stone. Immense, ancient, exposed. Suits frontier crossings, pursuit through ravines, prospectors, and vast indifferent country.
examples: The canyon walls went up on either side, red and striped, and the river was a thread far below.
She stood at the edge of the gorge. The sandstone was warm under her hand and the drop went down for ever.

scenes.name: Limestone Cavern
scenes.description: A vast underground chamber of pale limestone, still water holding a perfect reflection, stalactites overhead and no sound but dripping. Cold, echoing, otherworldly. Suits caves and tunnels, hidden sanctuaries, subterranean journeys, and discoveries made below ground.
examples: The torch showed a chamber so large the roof was lost. Still water lay across the floor, holding the stalactites upside down.
They went deeper into the cave. Water dripped somewhere and the pale stone of the walls glittered when the light touched it.

scenes.name: Volcanic Badlands
scenes.description: A blasted plain of black lava rock and sulphur-yellow crust, steam venting from fissures, nothing growing. Hostile, primordial, sulphurous. Suits forges and underworlds, blighted lands, trials of endurance, and the aftermath of catastrophe.
examples: The ground was black rock and yellow crust, and steam came up out of cracks in it. Nothing grew anywhere.
They picked their way across the lava field. The air stank of sulphur and the heat came up through their boots.

scenes.name: Aurora Over Tundra
scenes.description: Green light rippling across a black polar sky above an endless frozen plain, silent and enormous. Awed, solitary, numinous. Suits polar expeditions, long nights, visions and omens, and the feeling of being very small.
examples: The green light moved across the whole sky and the frozen plain ran out under it to the horizon, silent.
She lay on her back on the snow and watched the aurora ripple and fold. There was no sound at all.

scenes.name: Highland Moor
scenes.description: Rolling heather moorland swallowed in fog, peat underfoot and drystone walls appearing and vanishing. Bleak, lonely, ominous. Suits searches and disappearances, hauntings, walks gone wrong, and country far from help.
examples: The fog had the moor. Drystone walls appeared and vanished as they walked, and the heather was wet to the knee.
He lost the path in the peat and stood still, listening. Somewhere in the fog a sheep coughed.

scenes.name: Jungle Waterfall
scenes.description: A waterfall dropping into a green pool ringed by rainforest, spray hanging in the air, vines and broad leaves crowding the wet rock. Lush, loud, hidden. Suits expeditions, lost places, bathing and respite, and the deep interior of a jungle.
examples: The waterfall came down into the pool with a noise that filled the whole basin. Spray hung in the air and the vines dripped.
They climbed down through the rainforest to the water. It was green and cold and the falls roared over everything.

scenes.name: Olive Grove
scenes.description: Gnarled olive trees on dry stone terraces above a hot valley, cicadas going, silver leaves turning in the wind. Sun-baked, ancient, unhurried. Suits Mediterranean villages, old feuds and old families, summer heat, and classical antiquity.
examples: The olives were silver in the heat and the cicadas never stopped. She sat on the terrace wall and looked down into the valley.
He walked between the gnarled trunks on the dry terraces. The ground was hard and the grove smelled of dust and thyme.

scenes.name: Frozen Lake
scenes.description: A wide frozen lake ringed by leafless trees, ice creaking underfoot, tracks crossing the snow to nowhere. Cold, quiet, tense. Suits winter journeys, thin ice, isolation, and things hidden under the surface.
examples: The lake was frozen right across, and the bare trees stood around it. The ice creaked under her boots.
They crossed the ice in single file. Tracks went ahead of them in the snow toward the far shore.

scenes.name: Standing Stones
scenes.description: A ring of weathered standing stones on open grassland at first light, lichen-crusted and leaning, older than any record. Solemn, pagan, watchful. Suits folklore, ritual, deep history, and thresholds between worlds.
examples: The stones stood in their ring on the open grass, leaning, crusted with lichen. Light came up behind them.
She walked the circle of standing stones at first light and touched each one as she passed.

scenes.name: Cliff Path
scenes.description: A narrow path along the top of sea cliffs, gulls wheeling below, turf cropped short by the wind and a long drop to white water. Wind-scoured, vertiginous, bracing. Suits coastal walks, confrontations at the edge, watching for ships, and remote headlands.
examples: The path ran along the top of the cliff with the sea a long way below. Gulls wheeled under them, crying.
Wind came up over the headland and flattened the turf. He kept well back from the edge and watched the birds.

scenes.name: Northern Fishing Village
scenes.description: A small cold-water fishing village, painted wooden houses stacked above a stone quay, nets drying and boats knocking together in grey swell. Working, weathered, close-knit. Suits hard coastal lives, weather coming in, returning home, and communities that keep their own counsel.
examples: The boats were in and the nets were drying on the quay. Painted houses climbed the hill behind the harbour.
She walked down to the stone quay in the cold. Gulls sat on the boats and the whole village smelled of fish.

scenes.name: Lighthouse on the Headland
scenes.description: A white lighthouse on a bare headland above a heavy sea, its beam sweeping out through rain. Solitary, dutiful, exposed. Suits keepers and watchers, signals in the dark, isolation with a purpose, and nights when ships are in trouble.
examples: The lighthouse stood white on the headland with the sea heaving below it. Its beam went out through the rain.
They climbed the headland in the wind. The light swept over them and out to sea and back.

scenes.name: Wheat Field at Harvest
scenes.description: A wide field of ripe wheat moving in the wind, a distant barn, the harvest not yet in. Golden, laborious, fleeting. Suits farming years, summer's end, work that cannot wait, and the countryside just before a change.
examples: The wheat moved in the wind all the way to the barn, ripe and gold and not yet cut.
He walked into the field with the stalks up to his waist. The harvest would start tomorrow.

scenes.name: Vineyard in Autumn
scenes.description: Rows of vines on a slope turning red and gold after the grape harvest, mist pooled in the valley below. Ripe, settled, valedictory. Suits estates and inheritance, the end of a season's labour, long meals, and country wealth.
examples: The vines had turned red and gold on the slope and the grapes were in. Mist lay in the valley below.
She walked the rows of the vineyard in the early cold, the leaves crisp and the hills fading into haze.

scenes.name: Monastery Cloister
scenes.description: A stone cloister enclosing a plain garden, arcades on all four sides and no sound but footsteps on flagstones. Austere, ordered, contemplative. Suits scholars and monks, refuge, vows and obligations, and lives lived to a bell.
examples: The cloister enclosed a square of plain garden. Their footsteps were the only sound under the arcade.
He walked the four sides of the cloister slowly, past the columns, and came back to where he had begun.

scenes.name: Orchard in Blossom
scenes.description: An old orchard in full blossom, petals coming down in the wind and long grass between the trunks. Tender, transient, hopeful. Suits courtship, new beginnings, spring festivals, and happiness that will not last.
examples: The orchard was in full blossom and petals came down in the wind onto the long grass between the trunks.
She lay under the apple trees with the blossom drifting onto her face and the bees loud above.

scenes.name: Shepherd's Hut
scenes.description: A low drystone hut on empty upland grazing, smoke from a peat fire pulled sideways by the wind, sheep scattered on the slope. Rough, sheltering, remote. Suits hard winters, hiding out, hospitality from strangers, and country with no roads.
examples: The hut was low and made of drystone, and the smoke from its peat fire was pulled flat by the wind.
He ducked in through the door out of the weather. Inside, the fire and a bench and nothing else.

scenes.name: Country Churchyard
scenes.description: A small churchyard of leaning headstones under old yews, mist settling between them at the end of the day. Melancholy, quiet, freighted. Suits burials and remembrance, secrets kept by a village, ghosts, and the weight of the past.
examples: The headstones leaned under the yews and the mist was settling between them. It was nearly dark.
She found the grave at the end of the churchyard and stood there while the mist came in over the wall.

scenes.name: Medieval Market Square
scenes.description: A cobbled square crowded with stalls and awnings under timber-framed houses, produce and livestock and shouting. Busy, grubby, mercantile. Suits town life, proclamations and public punishment, pickpockets, and the day a stranger rides in.
examples: The square was full of stalls and shouting. Awnings flapped and livestock pushed through the crowd over the cobbles.
He shouldered through the market with the timbered houses leaning in overhead and the smell of bread and dung.

scenes.name: Narrow Alley
scenes.description: A tight alley of wet cobbles between high walls, a single lamp throwing long shadows and washing strung overhead. Furtive, cramped, threatening. Suits pursuit on foot, back-street meetings, cutpurses, and the parts of a city nobody maps.
examples: The alley was wet and narrow between high walls, and the one lamp threw his shadow far ahead of him.
She stepped into the alley and the noise of the street cut off. Cobbles, a lamp, a door somewhere ahead.

scenes.name: City Rooftops
scenes.description: A sea of tiled roofs and chimney stacks at dusk, smoke going up straight and the streets invisible below. Elevated, secretive, free. Suits escapes over the tiles, thieves and spies, cities seen from above, and stolen privacy.
examples: From the roof the city was a sea of tiles and chimneys with smoke going straight up into the dusk.
He sat on the ridge of the roof with the whole town spread below him and the lamps coming on one by one.

scenes.name: Grand Railway Station
scenes.description: A great iron-and-glass train shed full of steam and echo, departure boards and a clock high above the crowd. Cavernous, transitional, urgent. Suits departures and reunions, pursuit through crowds, wartime partings, and the beginning of a journey.
examples: The station roared with steam and echo. Departure boards clattered and the clock hung high above the crowd.
She hurried under the iron and glass of the great train shed, looking for the platform, her case banging her leg.

scenes.name: Textile Mill
scenes.description: A long mill floor of clattering looms and belt-driven shafting, lint hanging in the light from high windows. Deafening, relentless, industrial. Suits factory work, strikes and foremen, childhoods cut short, and the machinery of a new century.
examples: The looms clattered the whole length of the mill floor. Lint hung in the light and nobody could hear anybody.
He walked between the machines with the belts whipping overhead and the noise a solid thing.

scenes.name: Dockside Warehouses
scenes.description: Brick warehouses along a black river in fog, cranes overhead and crates stacked on a wet wharf. Commercial, shadowed, unwatched. Suits smuggling and cargo, meetings after dark, industrial ports, and business best done quietly.
examples: The warehouses stood along the black water in the fog. Cranes were shapes overhead and the wharf was wet.
They waited among the crates on the dock. Somewhere a ship's bell rang and the fog swallowed it.

scenes.name: Late Metro Platform
scenes.description: An empty underground platform late at night, tiled walls and fluorescent light, warm air pushed ahead of a train that has not arrived. Modern, hollow, suspended. Suits city solitude, waiting, near-misses, and journeys home that feel too long.
examples: The platform was empty at that hour. Tiled walls, fluorescent light, and warm air pushed ahead of a train that had not come.
She sat on the bench underground and watched the tunnel mouth. The last train was late.

scenes.name: Covered Bazaar
scenes.description: A vaulted bazaar hung with lanterns and carpets, spice sacks open and light coming down in dusty shafts. Crowded, aromatic, labyrinthine. Suits foreign cities, disappearing into a crowd, goods that arrived by long roads, and quarters a stranger gets lost in.
examples: Lanterns hung under the vault of the bazaar and carpets were piled everywhere. Spice sacks stood open in the aisles.
He lost her in the crowd of the bazaar. Light came down in dusty shafts and a hundred stalls shouted at once.

scenes.name: Tenement Courtyard
scenes.description: A narrow courtyard between tall tenements, washing strung across it and only a square of sky overhead. Poor, overlooked, communal. Suits crowded cities, hard childhoods, neighbours who hear everything, and lives lived close together.
examples: Washing was strung across the courtyard between the tenements and only a square of sky showed above.
She came out into the yard with the buildings going up on all sides and somebody's radio playing above.

scenes.name: Roadside Diner
scenes.description: A lone diner lit up at night beside an empty highway, neon humming and nothing else for miles. Modern, transient, lonely. Suits road journeys, drifters and strangers, late-night conversations, and small-town America.
examples: The diner was lit up alone beside the highway with nothing else for miles. The neon hummed.
He slid into a booth by the window. Outside, trucks went by on the road and the sign buzzed.

scenes.name: Cathedral Nave
scenes.description: The nave of a great cathedral, columns going up into shadow and coloured light falling across the stone floor. Sublime, cold, hushed. Suits faith and doubt, sanctuary, coronations and funerals, and spaces built to make a person feel small.
examples: The columns went up into shadow and coloured light lay across the stone floor of the nave.
She walked slowly up the aisle of the cathedral between the pews. Her steps came back off the vault.

scenes.name: Courtroom
scenes.description: An oak-panelled courtroom with a raised bench and a rail worn smooth by hands, benches empty and the air stale. Formal, adversarial, weighty. Suits trials and testimony, reputations at stake, the law as an instrument, and verdicts about to land.
examples: The courtroom was panelled in oak and the rail was worn smooth. The bench was raised and empty.
He stood in the dock while the jury filed in and the judge took the bench above him.

scenes.name: Hospital Ward at Night
scenes.description: A long ward of iron beds at night, one lamp burning at the nurse's desk and the rest in shadow. Vigilant, antiseptic, precarious. Suits illness and recovery, wartime nursing, deathbeds, and the hours when nothing can be done but wait.
examples: One lamp burned at the nurse's desk and the rest of the ward was in shadow, a row of iron beds breathing.
She lay awake in the ward listening to the man in the next bed and the nurse's shoes in the corridor.

scenes.name: Empty Theatre
scenes.description: A theatre auditorium with the house lights low, red velvet seats empty and the safety curtain down. Expectant, faded, theatrical. Suits performers and rehearsals, illusions, opening nights, and rooms that feel wrong when nobody is in them.
examples: The theatre was empty, the house lights low and the red seats folded. The safety curtain was down.
He stood on the stage and looked out at the rows of empty stalls going up into the dark.

scenes.name: Farmhouse Kitchen
scenes.description: A flagstoned kitchen with a fire in the range, a scrubbed table and things hung to dry from the beams. Warm, domestic, safe. Suits homecomings, family talk, shelter from weather, and the heart of a working house.
examples: The fire was in the range and the table was scrubbed. Things hung from the beams to dry over the flagstones.
She came into the farmhouse kitchen out of the cold and put her hands to the hearth.

scenes.name: Attic
scenes.description: An attic under bare rafters, trunks and sheeted furniture and a single window thick with dust. Forgotten, private, nostalgic. Suits discoveries, old letters and photographs, hiding, and the past kept just out of sight.
examples: The attic was bare rafters and dust, trunks and sheeted furniture and one small window thick with grime.
He climbed up into the loft and opened the nearest trunk. The dust rose in the light from the window.

scenes.name: Throne Room
scenes.description: A long stone hall hung with banners, a throne on a dais at the far end and a floor made for approaching slowly. Imposing, political, ceremonial. Suits courts and audiences, oaths, intrigue among the powerful, and the moment before a decision.
examples: Banners hung the length of the hall and the throne stood on its dais at the far end. The floor was made for approaching.
She walked the length of the throne room under the banners with every eye on her.

scenes.name: Prison Cell
scenes.description: A stone cell with a barred slit high in the wall, straw on the floor and marks scratched into the masonry. Confining, cold, interminable. Suits captivity, interrogation, waiting for judgement, and the slow measurement of time.
examples: The cell was stone, with straw on the floor and a barred slit high in the wall. Marks were scratched into the stone.
He lay on the straw in the cell and counted the scratches. The slit showed a piece of grey sky.

scenes.name: Victorian Laboratory
scenes.description: A cluttered private laboratory of brass instruments and glassware, specimen jars on the shelves and something still bubbling. Inquisitive, obsessive, faintly unwholesome. Suits experiments, inventors, discoveries that go too far, and the science of a confident century.
examples: Brass instruments and glassware crowded the laboratory bench. Specimen jars lined the shelves in the gaslight.
She bent over the apparatus with the burner hissing and the jars watching from the shelf.

scenes.name: Glasshouse
scenes.description: A Victorian glasshouse crowded with palms and ferns, condensation on the panes and iron ribs arching overhead. Humid, green, sheltered. Suits botanical obsession, convalescence, private conversations, and gardens kept alive against the climate.
examples: The glasshouse was thick with palms and ferns. Condensation ran down the panes and the iron ribs dripped.
He pushed in among the plants of the conservatory. The air was warm and wet and smelled of earth.

scenes.name: Wizard's Workroom
scenes.description: A tower room crowded with an orrery, chalked sigils and jars of things best not identified, lit by a floating glow. Arcane, obsessive, charged. Suits sorcery, apprentices, bargains struck with powers, and magic treated as a craft with a cost.
examples: The tower room was crowded with an orrery, chalked sigils on the floor and jars of things best not looked at.
She found him in the workroom among the jars and instruments with the sigils still glowing on the boards.

scenes.name: Dungeon Corridor
scenes.description: A low vaulted corridor of damp stone, torches spaced too far apart and iron doors along one side. Oppressive, echoing, dangerous. Suits descents, imprisonment, delving, and places built so that nobody comes back up.
examples: The corridor was low and damp and the torches were too far apart. Iron doors ran along one side.
They went down into the dungeon with one torch between them and the stone sweating on either side.

scenes.name: Airship Gondola
scenes.description: The cabin of an airship above a floor of cloud, brass fittings and a wide window, engines droning below. Adventurous, precarious, expansive. Suits voyages, mapping unknown country, escapes by air, and confidence in machines.
examples: The gondola hung above a floor of cloud. Brass fittings, a wide window, and the engines droning behind.
She stood at the window of the airship and watched the clouds go by beneath them like a white sea.

scenes.name: Overgrown Ruins
scenes.description: A city street reclaimed by trees, saplings through the tarmac and vines over the facades, silent of engines. Post-human, green, uncanny. Suits collapse and after, survivors, nature outlasting us, and cities remembered rather than lived in.
examples: Trees had come up through the tarmac and vines covered the facades. The street was silent.
He walked down the middle of the ruined avenue with saplings growing out of the cars.

scenes.name: Tokyo Backstreet
scenes.description: A narrow Tokyo backstreet after midnight, izakaya lanterns and vending machines throwing colour on wet asphalt, bicycles leaned against the railings. Modern, intimate, quietly alive. Suits contemporary Japanese fiction, drinking and talking late, wandering a city alone, and nights that do not end where they were meant to.
examples: The backstreet was narrow after midnight, izakaya lanterns lit and a vending machine throwing colour on the wet.
She turned off the main road into the alley. Lanterns, a drunk singing somewhere, the hum of a machine.

scenes.name: Convenience Store at Night
scenes.description: A convenience store lit up on an otherwise dark street, fluorescent white spilling across the pavement, shelves full and nobody inside. Modern, mundane, oddly comforting. Suits late shifts and insomnia, small purchases at strange hours, and contemporary Japanese and Korean fiction.
examples: The convenience store was lit white on a dark street. He went in for a coffee and stood at the counter reading a magazine.
She walked the aisles of the store at two in the morning under the fluorescent light, the shelves full and nobody else there.

scenes.name: Bullet Train Window
scenes.description: The window of a fast train crossing flooded rice fields, the landscape smeared by speed and the carriage almost silent. Modern, in transit, meditative. Suits journeys between cities, going back to a family you left, thinking at speed, and contemporary Japan.
examples: The train crossed the flooded rice fields at speed and the landscape smeared past the window.
He watched the paddies flash by, each one holding a piece of sky, the carriage barely moving under him.

scenes.name: Small Tokyo Apartment
scenes.description: A single-room apartment with the futon folded away, a low table and a sliding door onto a balcony of drying laundry. Modern, cramped, private. Suits living alone in a large city, starting again with very little, quiet routine, and contemporary Japanese fiction.
examples: The apartment was one room with the futon folded away and a low table. The sliding door gave onto a small balcony.
She sat at the low table in the flat with the door open to the balcony and the city noise coming in.

scenes.name: Covered Shopping Street
scenes.description: A covered shopping street with half the shutters down, banners and lanterns strung under a vaulted roof, footsteps carrying. Modern, faded, neighbourly. Suits small-town Japan, businesses closing for the last time, errands and gossip, and places past their best years.
examples: Half the shutters were down in the covered shopping street. Banners and lanterns hung under the roof.
He walked the arcade past the closed shops with the lanterns swinging above and his footsteps echoing.

scenes.name: Hong Kong High-Rises
scenes.description: A slot of sky between residential towers, air-conditioners and drying poles stacked forty floors up, humid and loud. Modern, vertiginous, packed. Suits dense city living, families in small flats, looking up from the street, and contemporary Chinese fiction.
examples: The towers went up forty floors on either side with air-conditioners and drying poles stacked all the way.
She looked up from the street at the slot of sky between the high-rises and the washing hanging out of every window.

scenes.name: Shanghai Riverfront
scenes.description: A river frontage at dusk with glass towers lit on the far bank and heavy colonial stone behind, ferries crossing. Modern, ascendant, showy. Suits new money and old, ambition in a large city, deals and reunions, and contemporary Shanghai.
examples: The glass towers were lit across the river and the old stone stood heavy behind them on the waterfront.
He leaned on the embankment at dusk and watched the lights come on across the water.

scenes.name: Shanghai Lane House
scenes.description: A narrow lane between brick terraces, bamboo poles of washing overhead and a shared tap against the wall. Old-city, communal, worn. Suits neighbourhood life in urban China, families living close together, a city changing around people, and twentieth-century Shanghai.
examples: The lane ran between brick terraces with bamboo poles of washing overhead and a shared tap against the wall.
She came down the narrow lane past the doorways, ducking the washing, to the tap at the end.

scenes.name: Beijing Hutong in Winter
scenes.description: A grey brick alley of single-storey courtyard houses in winter, bicycles frozen in place and cabbages stacked by a doorway. Cold, low-slung, traditional. Suits old Beijing, neighbours who have known each other for decades, hard northern winters, and family history.
examples: The alley was grey brick and single-storey courtyard houses, bicycles frozen in place and coal smoke in the cold.
He walked the hutong in the winter dusk past the red doors with his breath in front of him.

scenes.name: Seoul Rooftop
scenes.description: A rooftop above the city at night, water tanks and dishes underfoot, apartment blocks stacked away to the hills. Modern, elevated, restless. Suits young people in an unforgiving city, escapes upward, conversations nobody else hears, and contemporary Korean fiction.
examples: The rooftop was water tanks and dishes underfoot and apartment blocks stacked away into the night.
She sat on the roof with a can of beer and the city spread out below in lights.

scenes.name: Kitchen in the Morning
scenes.description: A clean contemporary kitchen in early light, a mug on the counter and the day not yet begun. Modern, ordinary, calm. Suits domestic life, conversations held over breakfast, marriages good and bad, and fiction set squarely in the present.
examples: The kitchen was clean and the light was early. A mug stood on the counter and nothing had started yet.
He rinsed the rice and set the pot on the ring. Outside the kitchen window the street was still quiet.

scenes.name: Bedroom, Morning
scenes.description: An unmade bed with light coming through half-drawn curtains, clothes over a chair and the room still quiet. Intimate, unguarded, still. Suits waking alone or not alone, mornings after, convalescence, and the private hours of a modern life.
examples: Light came through the half-drawn curtains onto the unmade bed. Clothes lay over the chair.
She woke to the bedroom already bright and lay looking at the ceiling for a while.

scenes.name: Living Room at Night
scenes.description: A dark living room lit only by a screen, the cushions dented and the rest of the house asleep. Modern, insomniac, insular. Suits nights that will not end, avoidance, families in one room and far apart, and contemporary domestic fiction.
examples: The living room was dark except for the screen. The cushions were dented and the rest of the house was asleep.
He sat on the sofa with the sound down and the television flickering over the walls.

scenes.name: Balcony Above the City
scenes.description: A small balcony above a lit city, a chair and a railing and traffic noise a long way down. Modern, perched, thoughtful. Suits smoking and thinking, calls taken outside, flats shared with people you are avoiding, and cities at night.
examples: The balcony was small, a chair and a railing, and the city was lit below with the traffic a long way down.
She stood at the railing with a cigarette and watched the cars go by many floors beneath her.

scenes.name: Café in the Afternoon
scenes.description: A café in the middle of a weekday afternoon, cups and laptops on scattered tables, low talk and the door going. Modern, public, unhurried. Suits working away from home, waiting for someone who is late, overheard conversations, and the ordinary present.
examples: The café was half full on a weekday afternoon, cups and laptops on the tables and low talk under the music.
He took the table by the window in the coffee shop and ordered, and watched the street while he waited.

scenes.name: Supermarket Aisle
scenes.description: A supermarket aisle under hard fluorescent light, shelves full and the shop all but empty. Modern, anonymous, faintly unreal. Suits errands that fill a gap, decisions made badly at the end of a day, chance encounters, and the flat surfaces of ordinary life.
examples: The supermarket aisle was bright and empty under the fluorescent light, the shelves full and the shop all but closed.
She pushed the trolley down the aisle past the cereals and stopped, unable to remember what she had come in for.

scenes.name: Suburban Street
scenes.description: A quiet residential street at dusk, lawns and parked cars and lights coming on behind curtains. Modern, uneventful, watchful. Suits the surface of family life, neighbours with secrets, coming home after a long absence, and the present day.
examples: The street was quiet at dusk, lawns and parked cars, and lights were coming on behind the curtains.
He walked home along the suburban road past the driveways with the sprinklers going.

scenes.name: Motel Room
scenes.description: A cheap motel room at night, two beds, a sign glowing through thin curtains and nothing personal anywhere. Transient, seedy, tense. Suits running from something, stakeouts, affairs, road journeys gone wrong, and rooms rented by the night.
examples: The motel room had two beds and a sign glowing through the thin curtains and nothing personal in it.
She lay on the motel bed with the television on and the highway going by outside.

scenes.name: Highway at Night
scenes.description: A road at night seen over the dashboard, headlights reaching a little way and the rest black. Modern, in motion, suspended. Suits long drives, leaving somewhere, conversations held side by side, and the hours when a journey stops feeling like progress.
examples: The road went ahead over the dashboard as far as the headlights reached and then it was black.
He drove on through the night with the motorway empty and the dashboard the only light.

scenes.name: Departure Gate
scenes.description: A departure gate late in the evening, rows of empty seats and a dark apron beyond the glass. Modern, liminal, delayed. Suits waiting, leaving a country, reunions that have not happened yet, and the strange calm of being between places.
examples: The departure gate was rows of empty seats late in the evening with the dark apron beyond the glass.
She sat at the gate with her bag between her feet and watched a plane taxi past the window.

scenes.name: Office After Hours
scenes.description: An open-plan office after hours, monitors asleep and a single desk lamp still burning. Corporate, deserted, late. Suits work that has taken over a life, staying behind to find something, ambition and its costs, and the present-day workplace.
examples: The office was empty after hours, monitors asleep and one desk lamp still burning.
He stayed at his desk long after the others had gone, the open-plan floor dark around him.

scenes.name: Interview Room
scenes.description: A bare interview room with the table bolted down, a recorder and two chairs facing each other. Institutional, adversarial, airless. Suits questioning, confessions and denials, the machinery of an investigation, and a person working out how much to say.
examples: The interview room was bare, the table bolted down, a recorder and two chairs facing each other.
She sat across the table from the detective while the recorder ran and the strip light buzzed.

scenes.name: Hospital Corridor
scenes.description: A hospital corridor in the small hours, vinyl underfoot and handrails running further than seems necessary. Clinical, endless, dread-filled. Suits waiting for news, illness in a family, decisions taken out of your hands, and the present-day machinery of care.
examples: The hospital corridor ran on under the lights with vinyl underfoot and handrails along both walls.
He walked the corridor in the small hours past the closed doors, looking for the ward.

scenes.name: Server Room
scenes.description: A room of racked machines behind glass, cold air and blinking indicators and a noise that never stops. Technical, sealed, indifferent. Suits data and surveillance, systems working without us, break-ins of a modern kind, and near-future fiction.
examples: The server room was cold and full of racked machines behind glass, indicators blinking, the noise never stopping.
She badged into the data centre and the noise of the fans hit her along with the cold.

scenes.name: Hotel Corridor
scenes.description: A hotel corridor of identical doors, patterned carpet running away under low lighting. Anonymous, repetitive, uneasy. Suits arrivals late at night, people who are not where they claim to be, business travel, and not knowing which door is yours.
examples: The hotel corridor ran away under low light, identical doors and patterned carpet the whole length.
He walked the hallway looking at the door numbers with his key card in his hand.

scenes.name: Temple Garden
scenes.description: A temple garden of moss and raked gravel under old maples, a stone basin dripping and nobody about. Ordered, ancient, quieting. Suits contemplation, discipline, seasons watched closely, and Japan beyond the modern city.
examples: The temple garden was moss and raked gravel under old maples. A stone basin dripped and nobody was about.
She sat on the veranda and looked at the garden, the gravel combed into lines and the maples just turning.

scenes.name: Path of Torii Gates
scenes.description: A path of vermilion gates climbing through cedar forest, the tunnel of them closing overhead. Sacred, repetitive, transporting. Suits pilgrimage, thresholds between worlds, spirits and old belief, and Japanese folklore.
examples: The vermilion gates climbed through the cedars one after another until the tunnel of them closed overhead.
He walked up through the torii with the forest dark on either side and the gates going on and on.

scenes.name: Ryokan Room
scenes.description: A tatami room with a low table and a scroll in the alcove, paper screens slid open onto a garden. Spare, hospitable, hushed. Suits travellers put up for the night, formality between strangers, rest after a journey, and traditional Japan.
examples: The tatami room had a low table and a scroll in the alcove, and the paper screens were slid open onto the garden.
She knelt at the low table in the inn with tea while the screens showed the garden going grey.

scenes.name: Hot Spring Town
scenes.description: A hot spring town under deep snow, steam lifting off a river between wooden inns, lanterns lit early. Warm, remote, restorative. Suits winter retreats, recovering from something, encounters away from home, and Japan in the cold months.
examples: Steam came off the river between the wooden inns and the hot spring town was deep in snow, lanterns lit.
He walked back to the inn through the snow with his hair wet from the bath and the lanterns glowing.

scenes.name: Scholar's Garden
scenes.description: A garden of rockery and still water, a round moon gate framing a view through to another courtyard. Refined, layered, deliberate. Suits poetry and painting, quiet wealth, arrangements made between families, and classical China.
examples: The garden was rockery and still water, and the moon gate framed the next courtyard like a picture.
She went through the round gate into the garden and the noise of the street was gone.

scenes.name: Courtyard House
scenes.description: A walled courtyard house with rooms on all four sides, a bare tree in the middle and red doors flaking. Enclosed, familial, old. Suits households under one roof, generations disagreeing, northern China, and a family with a long memory.
examples: The courtyard house had rooms on all four sides and a bare tree in the middle and red doors.
He crossed the courtyard under the bare tree to the room on the north side.

scenes.name: Rice Terraces
scenes.description: Flooded terraces stepping down a hillside at dawn, each one holding the sky, the paths between them barely wide enough. Agrarian, patient, luminous. Suits farming villages, labour repeated for generations, hillside country, and rural Asia.
examples: The terraces stepped down the hillside at dawn, each one flooded and holding the sky.
She walked the narrow paths between the paddies with the water bright on either side.

scenes.name: Cliff Monastery
scenes.description: A whitewashed monastery built into a cliff face at altitude, prayer flags snapping and the air thin. Remote, devotional, severe. Suits pilgrimage, high places, faith practised hard, and journeys to the edge of the map.
examples: The monastery was whitewashed and built into the cliff at altitude, prayer flags snapping in the thin air.
He climbed the last steps to the monastery with his lungs burning and the flags cracking overhead.

scenes.name: Monsoon Street
scenes.description: A packed street in heavy monsoon rain, shopfronts open to the downpour and water running ankle-deep. Drenched, loud, vivid. Suits the rainy season, cities that never pause, arriving somewhere overwhelming, and contemporary India.
examples: The street was packed and the monsoon rain came down in sheets, shopfronts open to it and water running ankle-deep.
She waded through the flooded street with the rain hammering the awnings and everyone shouting.

scenes.name: River Ghats
scenes.description: Wide stone steps going down to a slow river at first light, boats moored and smoke rising off the bank. Sacred, ancient, unhurried. Suits rituals repeated for centuries, death treated as ordinary, pilgrims, and the great rivers of India.
examples: The stone steps went down to the slow river at first light. Boats were moored and smoke rose off the water.
He sat on the ghat and watched the boats and the bathers as the sun came up over the far bank.

scenes.name: Stepwell
scenes.description: A vast inverted stairwell of stone descending to dark water, flights crossing each other all the way down. Geometric, cool, vertiginous. Suits hidden places, architecture as obsession, shelter from heat, and old India.
examples: The stepwell went down flight after flight of stone to dark water, the stairs crossing each other all the way.
She climbed down the stepwell into the cool, the geometry of the stairs closing over her.

scenes.name: Caravanserai
scenes.description: A walled desert inn at night, camels couched in the courtyard and fires burning under the arcades. A waypoint, guarded, transient. Suits long trade routes, strangers thrown together, stories told around a fire, and the Silk Road.
examples: The caravanserai was walled against the desert. Camels knelt in the courtyard and fires burned under the arcade.
He found a place by the fire in the courtyard of the inn with the camels groaning in the dark.

scenes.name: Palace Courtyard
scenes.description: A palace court of red sandstone and white marble, a channel of water running down the centre under a hot sky. Imperial, symmetrical, sun-struck. Suits courts and successions, intrigue in a hot climate, wealth without limit, and Mughal India.
examples: The palace courtyard was red sandstone and white marble with a channel of water running down the centre.
She walked beside the water channel through the palace court with the pavilions on either side.

scenes.name: Savanna at Dusk
scenes.description: Open grassland running to the horizon with flat-topped acacias in silhouette, dust hanging in the air at sunset. Vast, hot, ancient. Suits journeys across open country, herding and hunting, drought, and the African plains.
examples: The grassland ran to the horizon and the flat-topped acacias stood black against the dusk with dust hanging in the air.
He watched from the truck as the savanna went gold and then grey and the animals came down to drink.

scenes.name: Mud-Brick Town
scenes.description: A town built entirely of mud brick, walls shaped by hand with timber beams sticking out, everything the colour of the ground. Earthen, enduring, sun-hammered. Suits desert trade, scholarship in unexpected places, heat that stops the day, and the Sahel.
examples: The town was all mud brick, walls shaped by hand with timber beams sticking out, everything the colour of the ground.
She walked between the mud walls of the town in the heat with the beams throwing short shadows.

scenes.name: Soda Lake
scenes.description: A shallow alkaline lake under escarpments, flamingos a pink line on the water and heat shimmering off the flats. Mineral, wide, primeval. Suits expeditions, origins, wildlife and isolation, and the East African rift.
examples: The lake was shallow and white with salt under the escarpments, flamingos a pink line across it.
He stood on the shore of the soda lake in the heat shimmer and watched the birds lift and settle.

scenes.name: Colonial Plaza
scenes.description: A colonial plaza in the dead heat of the afternoon, arcades deep in shadow and shutters closed all round. Somnolent, ornate, waiting. Suits small towns where everyone knows everything, heat that stops work, old power, and Latin America.
examples: The plaza was dead in the afternoon heat, the arcades deep in shadow and every shutter closed.
She crossed the empty square at siesta with the church bell striking and nothing else moving.

scenes.name: Altiplano
scenes.description: A high treeless plain between snow peaks, tough grass and a thin track going nowhere visible. Thin-aired, immense, indifferent. Suits high crossings, altitude sickness, herders, and the Andes.
examples: The plain was high and treeless between the snow peaks, tough grass and a thin track going nowhere.
He walked the altiplano with the peaks white on either side and the air too thin to hurry.

scenes.name: River Town
scenes.description: Stilt houses along a wide brown river, boats tied beneath them and rain coming over the forest. Humid, improvised, remote. Suits river journeys, trade far from anywhere, fever and delay, and the interior of South America.
examples: The houses stood on stilts along the brown river with boats tied beneath them and rain coming over the forest.
She sat on the porch above the water and watched the boats go up the river into the rain.

scenes.name: Steppe
scenes.description: A white felt tent alone on open grassland, horses tethered and the weather visible an hour before it arrives. Nomadic, exposed, self-sufficient. Suits herding, vast distance, hospitality offered to travellers, and the steppe.
examples: The felt tent stood alone on the grassland with horses tethered outside and weather visible an hour away.
He rode across the steppe toward the yurt with the grass moving in waves and the sky enormous.

scenes.name: Imperial Audience Hall
scenes.description: The great audience hall of an imperial palace, red lacquered pillars rising to a gilded coffered ceiling, the dragon throne on a raised dais at the far end and a long floor of polished stone before it. Imperial, hushed, dangerous. Suits court audiences, ministers kneeling in rows, edicts read aloud, and power that decides lives with a single word.
examples: The ministers knelt in two long rows between the red pillars, and far off on the dais the emperor let the silence run.
A eunuch's voice rang out across the audience hall, and every official bowed until his forehead touched the cold stone.

scenes.name: Ancient Capital Street
scenes.description: A long street in an old imperial Chinese capital, shopfronts of carved timber and cloth banners on both sides, carts rolling on the stone flags and a drum tower closing the view at the far end. Busy, prosperous, full of rumour. Suits arriving in the capital, errands and chance meetings, being followed through a crowd, and a city that is always watching.
examples: The street ran straight to the drum tower, silk shops and apothecaries on either side, a hawker crying pears above the rumble of the carts.
She stepped down from the sedan chair into the crowded street of the old capital, cloth banners snapping over the shopfronts and a peddler catching at her sleeve.

scenes.name: Teahouse Upstairs
scenes.description: The upper floor of an old Chinese teahouse above a busy street, square tables of dark wood, lattice windows thrown open, a storyteller's table at one end and steam rising from the kettles. Lively, eavesdropping, convivial. Suits meeting a contact, overhearing gossip, a storyteller's tale of heroes, and a quarrel that starts over wine.
examples: Upstairs in the teahouse the waiter wove between the tables with a kettle, and the storyteller slapped down his block as the room went quiet.
He took a table by the open lattice, poured from the teapot, and watched the street below while the wine house filled up around him.

scenes.name: Wayside Inn
scenes.description: A roadside inn on a lonely highway in old China, a greasy common room of square tables and benches where a waiter with a towel over his shoulder runs between the guests, jars of wine along the wall, a lantern over the door and horses tethered in the yard. Rough, watchful, temporary. Suits travellers and swordsmen, a meal before danger, strangers sizing each other up, and a fight that starts over nothing.
examples: Under the wine flag of the roadside inn the swordsmen sat at the square tables with their sabers close to hand, and the waiter ran between them with jars of wine.
The inn stood alone where the road left the hills, its wine flag hanging limp, and inside a traveller in a bamboo hat ate beef without taking his hand from his saber.

scenes.name: Jiangnan Water Town
scenes.description: A water town in the south of China, whitewashed houses with black tile roofs standing straight out of a green canal, stone arch bridges linking the banks and covered boats sliding under them. Gentle, damp, unhurried. Suits journeys south, love letters and misunderstandings, rain on the water, and a family with secrets behind a canal gate.
examples: The water town was all white walls and black tiles, the canal running between the houses, and every few steps a stone arch bridge crossed it.
In the Jiangnan water town the black-awninged boats slid under stone arch bridges past white walls and grey tiles, and a woman washing clothes crouched on the canal steps.

scenes.name: Lantern Boats on the River
scenes.description: A river in an old southern Chinese city at night, painted pleasure boats hung with red lanterns moored along the bank, music and laughter behind gauze curtains and lantern light shaking on the black water. Seductive, glittering, decadent. Suits courtesans and poets, secret meetings on the water, a night of drinking, and gossip that travels faster than the boats.
examples: The painted pleasure boats lay moored in a line, their red lanterns doubled in the river, and a zither played somewhere behind a gauze curtain.
He stepped from the riverbank onto a painted pleasure boat hung with red lanterns, and a courtesan poured him wine while the river lights drifted past.

scenes.name: Mountain Temple in Mist
scenes.description: A Chinese Buddhist temple on a forested mountainside in mist, grey tiled halls with upturned eaves stacked up the slope, incense smoke drifting from a bronze burner and a long flight of worn stone steps. Remote, devout, timeless. Suits monks and pilgrims, retreat from the world, a master and a student, and news arriving from far below.
examples: The stone steps climbed through the mist to the temple gate, where incense smoke hung under the eaves and a monk was sweeping leaves.
At dawn the temple bell sounded down the mountain, and the monks knelt in the hall before the Buddha while incense smoke drifted out into the mist.

scenes.name: Imperial Archive Hall
scenes.description: A secret imperial Chinese bureau in a black, windowless building, long silent corridors lined with black-lacquered shelves of scroll cases and sealed files, and oil lamps burning on long desks. Secretive, orderly, faintly menacing. Suits spies and censors, secret files, investigations that reach the palace, and a clerk who knows too much.
examples: The bureau was a square black building with no windows, and in its long corridors there was no sound but footsteps and the scratch of the clerks' brushes.
In the imperial archive the black shelves ran back into the dark, row on row of sealed scroll cases, and the clerk of the secret bureau found the file without having to look.

scenes.name: Southern Fishing Town
scenes.description: A small fishing town on a warm southern coast of old China, boats pulled up on a grey beach, nets drying on poles and narrow lanes of stone houses with salted fish hung under the eaves. Humid, remote, slow. Suits a childhood far from the capital, waiting for letters, the smell of the fish market, and a quiet life that will not last.
examples: The fishing boats lay tilted on the beach at low tide, and down every lane the eaves were hung with rows of salted fish.
An old fisherman sat mending a net in his doorway, and the smell of the harbour came up the lane on the warm wind.

scenes.name: Hall of a Bronze-Age King
scenes.description: The painted hall of a Bronze Age Greek palace, a great round hearth burning in the middle of the floor between four red columns, smoke rising to an opening in the roof, bronze shields and spears hung on the plastered walls and fleeces spread for guests. Heroic, hospitable, crowded with suitors. Suits the palace of Ithaca, banquets and bards, a king returning in disguise, and hospitality with a knife under it.
examples: Smoke rose from the round hearth to the opening in the roof of the painted hall, and the suitors of the Greek palace lay on fleeces between the red columns, feasting.
In the great hall of the Bronze Age palace the bard sang of Troy by the round hearth, bronze shields gleaming on the plastered walls behind him.

scenes.name: Ancient Ship on a Calm Sea
scenes.description: A black-hulled oared ship of the ancient world running before the wind on a calm, wine-dark sea, a single square sail filled overhead, the oars shipped and no land anywhere. Vast, patient, exposed. Suits long voyages, homesickness, gods and omens, and the open sea between one island and the next.
examples: The black ship ran on before the wind with the oars shipped and the sail full above them, and the sea spread wine-dark to every side.
The oarsmen pulled the long black ship across an empty sea, the square sail slack on its mast and the helmsman watching the sky for wind.

scenes.name: Aegean Cove
scenes.description: A small sheltered cove on a rocky Aegean island, a crescent of pale sand, clear turquoise shallows and a black ship drawn up on the beach under goat-cropped cliffs. Bright, dry, inviting and uncertain. Suits landfall on an unknown island, a night on the shore, scouting inland for smoke, and a welcome that may not be a welcome.
examples: The cove was a crescent of white sand between the rocks of the island, and the water in it so clear they could see the stones on the bottom.
They beached the ship in the little cove and slept on the shore, and at first light climbed the goat paths up the cliff to look inland.

scenes.name: Greek Sanctuary
scenes.description: An ancient Greek sanctuary on a headland above the sea, a small temple of weathered stone columns, an altar blackened by fire before its steps and olive trees twisted by the wind. Sacred, sunlit, solemn. Suits sacrifices and prayers, oracles and omens, gods who may be listening, and oaths sworn at the altar.
examples: The temple stood on the headland among the olive trees, its stone columns pale against the sea, and smoke rose from the altar where the sacrifice burned.
The priest led them up between the columns of the sanctuary, where the offerings lay heaped and the sea glittered far below.

scenes.name: Island Grotto
scenes.description: A great grotto on a lush island, the cave mouth hung with vines heavy with grapes, clear springs running out through meadows of wild flowers, and dark cypress and alder crowding the slopes behind. Enchanted, abundant, a gilded prison. Suits a nymph's island, years of exile, longing for home, and a paradise that is also a trap.
examples: The grotto opened in the island's hillside, a vine heavy with grapes across its mouth and clear springs running out of it through the flowering meadows.
Deep in the cave the nymph sang at her loom beside a fire of cedar, and outside the grotto the island lay green and silent in the sun.

scenes.name: Shore of the Dead
scenes.description: A grey shore at the edge of the world where no sun reaches, black poplars and willows along a slow dark river, mist crawling over cold stones and a pit dug at the water's edge. Mournful, ghostly, forbidden. Suits journeys to the land of the dead, calling up the shades, prophecy and grief, and meeting those who cannot come back.
examples: At the edge of the world they reached the grey shore of the underworld, where the rivers of Hades meet, and the pale shades came crowding up out of the mist.
On the shore of Hades the dark river slid past black poplars without a sound, and the ghost of his mother stood on the bank and could not be held.

scenes.name: School Classroom
scenes.description: An ordinary school classroom after lessons, rows of wooden desks and chairs facing a blackboard still chalked with the day's work, a teacher's desk at the front and afternoon light across the floor from tall windows. Familiar, echoing, full of memory. Suits school days and exams, a new pupil, rivalries and first love, and a classroom revisited years later.
examples: The bell went and chairs scraped back across the classroom, and the teacher was still writing the homework on the blackboard.
She sat at her old desk by the window, where someone had carved initials into the wood, and the school was silent around her.

scenes.name: Abandoned Building
scenes.description: The inside of an abandoned concrete building, a stairwell choked with broken boards and rubble, water stains spreading over the walls and dusty light falling through empty window frames. Derelict, silent, hiding something. Suits a body discovered, children daring each other to go inside, a crime scene, and places the city has forgotten.
examples: The stairwell of the abandoned building was choked with rubble, and his torch caught a water stain on the wall shaped like a map.
The boys dared each other through the broken door. Inside, dust lay thick on the concrete and something had been dragged across it.

scenes.name: Hostess Lounge
scenes.description: A dim, expensive hostess lounge in a city nightlife district, curved velvet sofas round low tables, bottles glowing behind a small bar and a piano in the corner. Intimate, flattering, transactional. Suits businessmen and hostesses, secrets told over whisky, the night economy, and someone who is not what they seem.
examples: In the hostess club a woman in a silk dress poured his whisky and laughed at his jokes, and the piano in the corner of the lounge played something slow.
The lounge was low light and velvet sofas round small tables, a hostess at every man's side, and the bill came folded in a leather case.

scenes.name: Izakaya
scenes.description: The inside of a small Japanese izakaya in the evening, a wooden counter with stools, the cook grilling skewers over charcoal behind it, paper menus on the walls and steam and smoke in the lamplight. Warm, noisy, unbuttoned. Suits drinking after work, colleagues and old friends, confessions over beer, and a regular's seat at the counter.
examples: At the izakaya counter the cook turned the skewers over the charcoal, and the men beside them loosened their ties and called for more beer.
She ducked under the noren into the izakaya's steam and noise, took the last seat at the counter, and the owner poured her sake and set down a plate of yakitori.

scenes.name: Department Store
scenes.description: The ground floor of a large department store, glass counters of cosmetics and perfume under bright even light, polished floors, and escalators rising through an atrium to floor after floor of goods. Glossy, attentive, aspirational. Suits shopping and gifts, a chance meeting among the counters, a shop girl's life, and the respectable face of the city.
examples: The department store smelled of a hundred perfumes, and at the foot of the escalator a shop assistant bowed to every customer who stepped on.
She rode the escalator up through the department store, floor after floor of goods under the atrium lights, a shopping bag on her wrist.

scenes.name: Golf Driving Range
scenes.description: A covered multi-storey golf driving range in the evening, tiers of hitting bays under floodlights facing a wide green field closed in by tall netting, a ball machine clicking out ball after ball and distance markers scattered across the grass. Repetitive, sociable, faintly lonely. Suits businessmen practising their swing, a conversation between shots, an alibi, and money looking for something to do.
examples: Every bay at the golf driving range was taken, men in shirtsleeves hitting ball after ball out under the floodlights into the tall green netting.
At the practice range the ball machine clicked out another golf ball onto the mat, he swung his driver, and it flew out under the floodlights into the green netting.

scenes.name: Tokyo Crossing
scenes.description: A huge scramble crossing in central Tokyo at night, zebra stripes running in every direction across wet asphalt, giant video screens and lit facades towering on every side and the lights about to change. Overwhelming, electric, anonymous. Suits arriving in the big city, losing someone in a crowd, youth and nightlife, and being alone among thousands.
examples: The lights changed and the crowd surged across the crossing from every corner at once, under screens that flashed the same advert over and over.
She waited at the edge of the Shibuya crossing in the rain, the giant screens above the intersection throwing colour over a thousand umbrellas.

scenes.name: Night Market
scenes.description: A crowded night market in an East Asian city, rows of food stalls under strings of bare bulbs and awnings, smoke rising from grills and woks, and a narrow aisle between them packed with people. Hot, loud, delicious. Suits eating on the street, a date or a family outing, a pickpocket in the crowd, and the life of the city after dark.
examples: The night market was packed shoulder to shoulder, smoke rolling off the grills and the vendors shouting over the hiss of the woks.
They ate skewers standing up by a stall under a string of bare bulbs, and the crowd pushed past them toward the noodle stands.

scenes.name: Restaurant
scenes.description: The dining room of a good restaurant in the evening, white tablecloths and candles on tables set well apart, wine glasses catching the light, waiters moving between them and the kitchen door swinging at the back. Elegant, discreet, a stage for conversation. Suits dinners and dates, business deals, anniversaries that go wrong, and news delivered over dessert.
examples: The waiter led them to a table by the window, lit the candle, and handed over the wine list while the restaurant filled around them.
Over dessert she put down her fork and told him, and at the next table in the dining room a couple laughed at something else.

scenes.name: Bar
scenes.description: A long wooden bar in a city pub late in the evening, bottles lined up against a mirror behind it, brass taps and a row of stools, low lamps and the rest of the room in soft shadow. Relaxed, confessional, a little sad. Suits drinking alone, meeting a stranger, a bartender who listens, and the last round before closing.
examples: He took a stool at the bar and the bartender pulled him a pint without being asked, and the jukebox changed to something old.
It was nearly closing and the pub had emptied out, just her and the whisky and the bartender polishing glasses under the mirror.

scenes.name: City Park
scenes.description: A large park in the middle of a city in soft daylight, paths winding under old elms past lawns and a pond, benches and lamp posts along the way and the skyline showing above the trees. Green, sociable, a breathing space. Suits walks and conversations, jogging and dog-walking, a first date on a bench, and meeting someone by chance.
examples: She walked through the park under the elms, joggers passing, and sat down on a bench where the lawn ran down to the pond.
They spread the picnic on the grass while a dog chased pigeons across the lawn, and the city hummed beyond the trees.

scenes.name: Manhattan Avenue
scenes.description: A Manhattan avenue running straight between towers of glass and old stone, yellow cabs in the traffic, steam rising from a grate and the street a deep canyon under a strip of sky. Fast, enormous, indifferent. Suits New York stories, ambition and loneliness, hailing a cab in the rain, and a city that never looks up.
examples: Fifth Avenue ran straight between the skyscrapers of Manhattan, yellow cabs honking at the corner and steam rising from a grate in the street.
She came up out of the subway into midtown Manhattan at rush hour, the sidewalk packed under the towers, and raised her arm for a taxi that did not stop.

scenes.name: Lecture Hall
scenes.description: A steep university lecture hall of tiered wooden benches curving down to a podium and a wide screen, afternoon light from high windows and a projector humming in the gloom. Academic, crowded then empty, anonymous. Suits student life, lectures and seminars, a professor with a secret, and sitting at the back beside someone new.
examples: The lecture hall sloped down toward the podium, and the students filed in with coffee, opened their laptops and waited for the professor.
She slipped into the back row as the projector hummed on, and the lecture had already started without her.

scenes.name: Gym
scenes.description: A big modern gym early in the morning, racks of weights and benches along a mirrored wall, rows of treadmills facing tall windows and rubber floor mats under bright even light. Sweaty, disciplined, self-absorbed. Suits training and routine, a new body or a new life, conversations between sets, and pushing past a limit.
examples: The gym smelled of rubber and sweat, weights clanked back onto the rack, and a row of treadmills hummed under the long mirror.
At the gym he racked the barbell and sat up on the bench, and his trainer checked the clock on the mirrored wall and told him one more set.

scenes.name: Airplane Cabin
scenes.description: The cabin of a passenger airliner on a night flight, rows of seats in dim blue light, the window blinds mostly down, one oval window showing clouds lit by the moon and the engines droning. Suspended, cramped, between lives. Suits long-haul journeys, leaving home or coming back, strangers in adjacent seats, and thinking at thirty thousand feet.
examples: The cabin lights dimmed, the engines droned on, and she pulled the blind down over the little window and tipped her seat back.
The flight attendant came down the aisle with the trolley, and the passenger by the window slept on through the turbulence.

scenes.name: Golf Course
scenes.description: A green golf course on a still morning, a smooth fairway running between stands of pine to a flag on the putting green, a pond and a white sand bunker beside it and a clubhouse far behind. Manicured, affluent, quietly competitive. Suits business deals on the fairway, club members and their politics, a caddie who sees everything, and a round that matters more than it should.
examples: The fairway ran green and even between the pines to the flag, a pond glinting beside the putting green, and he took his time lining up the putt.
On the eighteenth fairway his caddie handed him the iron, and beyond the bunker the flag on the putting green stood still in the evening light.

scenes.name: Amusement Park
scenes.description: An amusement park at dusk as the lights come on, a Ferris wheel turning slowly above the midway, the frame of a roller coaster against the sky, and carousel horses and game stalls glowing below. Giddy, nostalgic, a little melancholy. Suits childhood outings, first dates and teenage dares, a lost child in the crowd, and happiness that knows it will end.
examples: The Ferris wheel turned slowly over the amusement park, the roller coaster rattled past overhead, and the smell of popcorn drifted from the stalls.
At the top of the Ferris wheel their car stopped and swung, and below them the whole fairground was lights and music and small running figures.

scenes.name: Stadium
scenes.description: A great sports stadium under floodlights before a match, tier upon tier of empty seats rising round a bright green pitch, the roof edge lit against a dark sky and the air waiting to fill with noise. Vast, tribal, electric. Suits the big game, fans and rivals, a career decided in ninety minutes, and forty thousand voices at once.
examples: The stadium roared as the teams ran out onto the pitch, forty thousand voices under the floodlights and the grass shining wet below them.
From the top of the grandstand the pitch looked impossibly small, and when the goal went in the whole stadium rose to its feet at once.

scenes.name: Swimming Pool
scenes.description: An indoor swimming pool early in the morning, long lanes of still blue water under a high glazed roof, rope lines floating on the surface and wavering light thrown up across pale tiled walls. Echoing, clean, solitary. Suits training at dawn, a swimmer's discipline, a confrontation at the water's edge, and the calm of doing lengths.
examples: The swimming pool was empty but for one swimmer doing lengths, the water throwing wavering light up the tiled walls and the air thick with chlorine.
She stood on the poolside in her goggles, toes curled over the edge, while the lifeguard yawned in his high chair above the still blue lanes.

scenes.name: Tennis Court
scenes.description: An outdoor tennis court at a private club on a summer afternoon, red clay lined with white, a sagging net, a high wire fence hung with towels and trees throwing shade along one side. Genteel, competitive, sunlit. Suits club rivalries, lessons with a coach, a match that is really an argument, and the leisure of people with money.
examples: On the tennis court the ball came back and forth across the net, and she bent to pick another one off the red clay by the baseline.
Towels hung on the wire fence of the tennis club, and between serves he could hear his coach calling from the shade under the trees.

scenes.name: Museum Gallery
scenes.description: A quiet gallery in a great art museum, tall walls hung with old paintings in gilt frames, a polished wooden floor, a bench in the middle of the room and doorways opening onto more rooms beyond. Hushed, cultured, contemplative. Suits standing before a painting, a meeting disguised as a visit, art theft and forgery, and silence shared with strangers.
examples: The gallery was hushed, and she stood a long time before the painting in its gilt frame while the guard shifted his weight by the door.
They met on the bench in the middle of the museum's Dutch room, facing the same canvas, and neither looked at the other.

scenes.name: Concert Hall
scenes.description: A grand concert hall before the performance, a lit stage with a grand piano and rows of empty chairs and music stands, tiers of red seats and gilded balconies rising round it and a great organ at the back. Expectant, refined, resonant. Suits a debut, an orchestra and its rivalries, music that changes a life, and a seat beside the wrong person.
examples: The orchestra filed onto the stage of the concert hall, the violins tuning, and the conductor raised his baton over the silence.
When the last chord faded the whole concert hall stayed silent for a breath, and then the applause came rolling down from the balconies.

scenes.name: Karaoke Room
scenes.description: A private karaoke room at night in an East Asian city, a U-shaped sofa round a low table crowded with drinks and snacks, a big screen scrolling lyrics, microphones on the table and coloured lights sweeping the dark. Loud, cramped, cathartic. Suits office parties and old classmates, singing to someone who is not listening, confessions between songs, and a night that goes on too long.
examples: In the karaoke room the lyrics scrolled across the big screen, and he held the microphone in both hands and sang the old love song badly.
The KTV booth was hot and dark, bottles crowding the low table, coloured lights sweeping over the sofa while someone shook a tambourine out of time.

scenes.name: Game Arcade
scenes.description: A crowded game arcade at night in a Japanese or Chinese city, rows of glowing machines and claw cranes full of plush toys, rhythm games flashing and the noise of a hundred jingles at once. Bright, frantic, adolescent. Suits teenagers after school, killing time, a first date over a claw machine, and a hideout from home.
examples: The arcade was all flashing screens and jingles, and he fed coins into the claw machine while she pressed her face to the glass.
After school they went to the game centre and played the drumming game until their arms ached, tokens spilling from their pockets.

scenes.name: School Library
scenes.description: A school library in the afternoon, long reading tables where students sit in uniform, rows of wooden shelves with numbered spines, curtains half drawn against the sun and a librarian's counter with a date stamp by the door. Quiet, studious, a refuge. Suits a lonely student, notes passed between shelves, first love over borrowed books, and the one place nobody at school looks for you.
examples: The school library was quiet but for turning pages, and she sat at the far table by the window with the borrowing card tucked into her book.
The librarian stamped the date inside the cover and slid the book across the counter, and he went back between the shelves to wait for her.

scenes.name: School Rooftop
scenes.description: The flat rooftop of a school building in East Asia, a high wire fence round the edge, a water tank and the stairwell door, and the town spread out below under a wide sky. Open, secret, adolescent. Suits skipping class, lunch away from everyone, confessions and fights, and the place students go to be alone.
examples: At lunch she climbed the stairs to the school rooftop and sat against the water tank, the fence humming in the wind and the town spread out below.
They skipped the last class and went up onto the roof, where the wind flattened their uniforms and nobody in the classrooms could see them.

scenes.name: Police Squad Room
scenes.description: A crowded police squad room, steel desks pushed together under fluorescent light, phones ringing, files stacked high and a whiteboard covered in photographs, maps and arrows. Overworked, tense, smoky with old habits. Suits detectives on a case, a murder board, a suspect's name on everyone's lips, and a department that does not trust itself.
examples: The squad room was blue with smoke, the phones ringing on every desk, and the detective pinned another photograph to the whiteboard beside the map.
At the police station the case files were stacked to the ceiling, and the chief called the detectives in and closed the door behind them.

scenes.name: Magistrate's Court
scenes.description: The hall of a county magistrate in old China, the magistrate's table on a raised platform under a great hanging plaque, red-and-black tallies in a pot, rows of constables with staves and the stone floor where the accused must kneel. Stern, theatrical, unjust. Suits trials and confessions, a wronged widow's petition, punishment with the staff, and justice that depends on who you know.
examples: The magistrate slammed the gavel on his table beneath the great plaque, and the constables struck their staves on the yamen floor as the accused knelt.
The county magistrate slammed down his gavel block, the constables on both sides roared together, and the prisoner kneeling on the stones below began to shake.

scenes.name: Bookshop
