scenes.description: A narrow second-hand bookshop on a side street, books piled to the ceiling with a wooden ladder against the shelves, a bell over the door, a bookseller at the counter under a green-shaded lamp and rain on the shop window. Cosy, dusty, eccentric. Suits browsing on a wet afternoon, a rare book with a secret, a bookseller who knows every reader, and a meeting between the shelves.
examples: The bookshop was narrow and tall, a ladder leaning against the shelves, and the bookseller was reading behind the counter under a green lamp.
She bought the first edition from the bookseller for almost nothing, and outside the bookshop window the rain went on falling on the side street.

scenes.name: Boutique
scenes.description: An expensive fashion boutique, a pale carpeted room with only a few clothes hung far apart on rails, a mirrored fitting room, a glass counter and a window display of three garments facing the street. Refined, intimidating, exclusive. Suits shopping with money or pretending to, a shop assistant's judgement, gifts and bribes, and a woman remaking herself.
examples: The boutique window held only three dresses, and inside the shop assistant folded a silk scarf into tissue paper as if it were alive.
She stepped out of the boutique's fitting room in the black dress, and the shop assistant stood back from the mirror and said nothing, which was the point.

scenes.name: Pawnshop
scenes.description: A small pawnshop, a high wooden counter with a steel grille between the owner and the customer, watches and rings in a glass case, tickets on a spike and a lamp over the ledger. Shabby, suspicious, desperate. Suits pawning something precious, a debt that cannot wait, a pawnbroker who asks no questions, and a murder that starts with a missing ring.
examples: The pawnbroker held the watch up to the lamp behind his grille for a long time, then wrote a figure in the ledger and pushed the ticket across.
The pawnshop smelled of dust and metal polish, and rings and watches lay in the glass case like things that had been given up.

scenes.name: Pharmacy
scenes.description: A small neighbourhood pharmacy, white shelves of medicine boxes behind a counter, a pharmacist in a white coat measuring out pills, a bell over the door and a green cross glowing faintly outside. Clean, quiet, discreet. Suits prescriptions and poisons, a pharmacist who notices things, illness in the family, and a small-town secret.
examples: The pharmacist in her white coat counted the pills into a little envelope behind the counter, and the bell over the pharmacy door rang once.
He handed the prescription across the drugstore counter and waited among the shelves of medicine while the chemist read it twice.

scenes.name: Old Wooden Apartment
scenes.description: An old two-storey wooden apartment building in a Japanese city, a narrow open corridor of identical doors with shoes and umbrellas outside them, an iron staircase on the outside and laundry hanging over the rail. Cheap, cramped, overheard. Suits poverty and students, neighbours who know too much, a lonely tenant, and the seventies and eighties in a working-class district.
examples: The corridor of the wooden apartment was narrow, shoes set out by every door, and the iron staircase rang under his feet as he climbed to the second floor.
Through the thin walls of the apartment she could hear the neighbour's radio and his cough, and the landlady's sandals going past on the boards.

scenes.name: Chinese Apartment Block
scenes.description: A flat in an ageing Chinese apartment block, a red-painted concrete floor, a family photograph on the wall above a sofa with a lace cover, a television on a cabinet and a stairwell outside crowded with bicycles and boxes. Familiar, crowded, lived-in. Suits family life and arguments, grandparents and children, a small home in a big city, and the ordinary years of modern China.
examples: In the concrete stairwell of the old apartment block cabbages were stacked on every landing for the winter, and the family's door on the fifth floor had its New Year paper pasted on.
In the flat the family photograph hung above the sofa with its lace cover, the thermos stood by the enamel basin, and grandmother sat folding dumplings with the television on.

scenes.name: Brownstone Street
scenes.description: A tree-lined street of brownstone townhouses in Brooklyn in autumn, high stoops with iron railings climbing to front doors, leaves on the steps and parked cars under the plane trees. Gracious, residential, New York. Suits families and neighbours, a stoop conversation, moving in or moving out, and a neighbourhood changing around its people.
examples: They sat on the stoop of their Brooklyn brownstone in the evening, leaves drifting onto the steps, and watched the neighbours come home under the plane trees.
The Brooklyn street was lined with townhouses and old plane trees, iron railings climbing every stoop, and a moving van was double-parked outside number forty.

scenes.name: Paris Café Terrace
scenes.description: The terrace of a Paris café on a grey afternoon, small round tables and wicker chairs in rows facing the boulevard, an awning overhead, a zinc bar glimpsed inside and cream stone apartment buildings with iron balconies across the street. Elegant, idle, observant. Suits watching the world go by, lovers and writers, an affair begun over coffee, and Paris in any decade.
examples: They took a table on the café terrace facing the boulevard, and the waiter brought two espressos and left them alone to watch Paris go by.
On the café terrace she sat in a wicker chair with her coffee going cold, watching the Paris boulevard, and across the street the iron balconies were full of geraniums.

scenes.name: Shanghai Skyline at Night
scenes.description: The skyline of Pudong in Shanghai at night seen from high up, a forest of glass towers lit in blue and gold, the river curving below with the lights of boats on it and the city running out to the horizon. Dazzling, ambitious, cold. Suits new money and old dreams, a view from an office at the top, lovers above the city, and the speed of modern China.
examples: From the observation deck on the ninetieth floor the Lujiazui skyline was a forest of lit glass towers, and the Huangpu river curved below like a band of light.
He stood at the penthouse window with the whole of Shanghai spread out beneath him in blue and gold, and the city lights ran all the way to the dark.

scenes.name: Red Palace Walls
scenes.description: A long lane between high red walls inside an imperial Chinese palace, golden-tiled roofs just showing over the top, a narrow strip of sky, snow on the stone flags and a single gate far down the lane. Enclosed, watchful, lonely. Suits palace intrigue, a concubine's walk, messages passed in secret, and a life lived behind walls.
examples: The lane ran on between the high red palace walls, golden roofs just showing above them, and a eunuch hurried past her with his head down.
Snow lay on the flagstones of the inner court, and the concubine walked slowly between the red walls with a maid holding a lantern at her side.

scenes.name: Examination Hall
scenes.description: The imperial examination compound of old China, row upon row of numbered brick cells no wider than a man's shoulders along narrow lanes, candidates grinding ink and writing with brushes on plank desks, and officials pacing under the eaves. Cramped, anxious, fateful. Suits scholars at the imperial examinations, years of study decided in three days, cheating and its punishment, and the road to office.
examples: In the examination compound each candidate sat alone in a brick cell barely wide enough to turn in, grinding ink and writing with his brush while officials paced under the eaves.
Row after row of examination cells ran away under the watchtower, and in every one of them a scholar bent over his essay with a brush.

scenes.name: City Gate and Walls
scenes.description: The great gate of a walled Chinese city, a massive gatehouse tower with upturned eaves above a deep arched passage, grey brick walls running away on either side, banners on the battlements and a road leading up to it. Formidable, watchful, a threshold. Suits arrivals and departures, sieges, guards checking papers, and news brought in from the frontier.
examples: The city gate loomed over the road, its gatehouse tower dark against the snow, and the guards at the arch stamped their feet and checked every cart.
From the battlements of the city wall the banners snapped in the wind off the frontier, and the sentry watched the dust of riders on the plain.

scenes.name: Herder's Cave
scenes.description: A vast cave in a rocky hillside used by a herdsman, pens of sheep and goats built against the walls, wicker racks of cheeses, a great stone rolled beside the entrance and firelight on the rough rock. Primitive, dangerous, rank with animals. Suits a giant's lair, being trapped with no way out, cunning against strength, and hospitality refused.
examples: The cave was vast and smelled of sheep, pens of lambs and kids along its walls and great round cheeses drying in wicker racks by the fire.
The giant rolled the boulder across the cave mouth and sat down among his goats, and in the firelight they saw there was no other way out.

scenes.name: Bronze-Age Walled City
scenes.description: The high stone walls of a Bronze Age city on a hill above a windy plain, massive gates and towers, and far off on the shore the dark hulls of a besieging fleet drawn up in lines. Epic, doomed, besieged. Suits a long siege, warriors on the ramparts, a city watching its champions fight below, and the end of a world.
examples: The great walls of Troy rose above the plain, towers and gates of massive stone, and from the ramparts the old king watched the chariots raise the dust below.
The citadel stood high above the windy plain, its great gates shut and barred, and the warriors on the walls leaned on their spears and waited.

scenes.name: Medieval Tavern
scenes.description: A low smoky tavern in a medieval town, a fire roaring in a wide stone hearth, rough tables and benches, casks along the wall, rushes on the floor and a staircase up to rooms for travellers. Rowdy, warm, full of strangers. Suits travellers meeting by chance, a bard and a brawl, rumours of a quest, and a room for the night.
examples: The tavern was low and smoky, a fire roaring in the hearth, and the innkeeper drew ale from a cask while a fiddler played in the corner.
He pushed through the crowded tavern with a tankard in each hand, past the fire in the great hearth and two men squaring up over a game of dice.

scenes.name: Edo Street
scenes.description: A street in old Edo Japan, rows of wooden townhouses with lattice fronts and dark tiled roofs, indigo noren curtains hanging over shop doorways, a drainage channel along the packed earth and a fire watchtower above the roofs. Bustling, orderly, pre-modern. Suits samurai and merchants, a ronin looking for work, festivals and fires, and the floating world of old Tokyo.
examples: The street was lined with lattice-fronted townhouses, indigo noren hanging over the shop doors, and a samurai with two swords at his hip ducked out of a merchant house.
In old Edo the ronin walked down the street past the tea stalls and the fire tower, looking for a house that would hire a masterless sword.

scenes.name: Japanese Castle
scenes.description: A Japanese castle keep rising in white plaster tiers above curving stone ramparts and a moat, dark wooden gables and upturned roofs at every level, pine trees leaning over the water. Imposing, feudal, beautiful. Suits a lord and his retainers, sieges and loyalty, a messenger arriving at the gate, and the age of the samurai.
examples: The castle rose in white tiers above the stone ramparts, its dark roofs curving at every level, and the daimyo's banners hung still over the moat.
The messenger crossed the bridge over the moat at a run, and the samurai at the castle gate lowered their spears to let him through.

scenes.name: Samurai Residence
scenes.description: The inside of a samurai's house in old Japan, a dark-beamed tatami room opening onto a veranda and a raked garden, a suit of armour on its stand, swords on a rack in the alcove and a single hanging scroll. Austere, disciplined, restrained. Suits duty and honour, a household under strain, a quiet conversation that decides a death, and the last days of a way of life.
examples: The samurai knelt on the tatami facing the garden, his swords on the rack in the alcove behind him, and did not turn when his wife slid the shoji open.
In the samurai's house the suit of armour stood in the corner of the dark tatami room, and the old retainer knelt beside the sword rack and waited to be spoken to.

scenes.name: Tea Ceremony Room
scenes.description: A tiny tea-ceremony room of four and a half tatami mats, rough clay walls, a low crawl-through door, an iron kettle steaming over a sunken hearth and a single flower in the alcove. Still, deliberate, profound. Suits the way of tea, a master and a guest, a truce between enemies over one bowl, and beauty in poverty.
examples: In the tea room the master whisked the matcha in the bowl without a sound, and the iron kettle over the sunken hearth sang very softly.
He crawled through the low door into the tea hut, knelt on the tatami, and turned the tea bowl twice in his hands before he drank.

scenes.name: Post Town Inn
scenes.description: Inns along an old Japanese highway post town at dusk, wooden two-storey inns with lanterns lit under the eaves, straw sandals and travellers' hats hung by the entrances, and the road running on between cedars into the mountains. Welcoming, weary, transitory. Suits journeys on foot along the old roads, pilgrims and messengers, an encounter at an inn, and a night before the mountain pass.
examples: At dusk they reached the post town on the old Tokaido road, lanterns lit under the eaves of every inn, and a maid came out to wash the dust from their feet.
The pilgrims hung their straw hats by the door of the inn at the post station, and beyond the last house the old road climbed into the cedars.

scenes.name: Cloud-Sea Peaks
scenes.description: Sheer granite peaks rising out of a sea of cloud, twisted pines clinging to the rock, a pavilion with upturned eaves on the highest summit and cranes flying between the pinnacles. Transcendent, immortal, remote. Suits cultivators and immortals, a sect on the mountain, a master's teaching, and a world above the world.
examples: The peaks rose out of the cloud sea like islands, twisted pines on every ledge, and a crane flew between them toward the pavilion on the summit.
The disciples rode their flying swords from peak to peak above the clouds, and the old immortal watched them from the highest pinnacle.

scenes.name: Sect Hall
scenes.description: The great hall of a martial arts sect on a mountaintop, a wide stone training ground before it where disciples drill, a hall of dark timber and grey tiles with a great plaque over the doors, bronze censers smoking and mountains fading into mist behind. Disciplined, proud, secretive. Suits a sect and its disciples, trials of skill, a master's succession, and rivalries between schools.
examples: At dawn the disciples of the sect drilled with their swords on the training ground before the great hall, their white robes moving as one.
The elders sat in a row in the martial hall beneath the plaque, incense rising from the censers, and the young disciple knelt to hear their verdict.

scenes.name: Cultivation Cave
scenes.description: A hermit's meditation cave high in the Chinese mountains, a smooth stone platform for sitting, a trickle of spring water into a rock pool, a few scrolls and a lamp, and pale light and mist at the cave mouth. Solitary, still, ascetic. Suits secluded cultivation, years of practice alone, a breakthrough or a rival's intrusion, and a hermit who has left the world.
examples: In the mouth of his cave high on the cliff the hermit sat cross-legged on a stone platform in secluded cultivation, water dripping into the rock pool behind him.
The hermitage was only a cave high on the cliff, a lamp and a few scrolls, and the hermit had not spoken aloud in seven years of cultivation.

scenes.name: Roman Forum
scenes.description: The forum of ancient Rome in its glory, white marble temples and colonnades round a paved square, bronze statues on tall pedestals, a triumphal arch and steps leading up to a basilica under a hot blue sky. Grand, political, crowded with ambition. Suits senators and orators, the politics of the Republic, a conspiracy in the colonnade, and the centre of the world.
examples: The senators crossed the forum in their white togas, between the marble temples and the statues on their pedestals, arguing all the way to the senate house.
An orator stood on the rostra in the heat of the forum, and the crowd under the colonnade went quiet to hear what he would say about Caesar.

scenes.name: Roman Villa Atrium
scenes.description: The atrium of a wealthy Roman villa, a shallow pool open to the sky in the middle of a mosaic floor, painted red and ochre walls, columns and doorways leading to rooms and a garden glimpsed beyond. Cultured, private, comfortable. Suits family and slaves, a patron and his clients, dinner parties and poison, and domestic life in the ancient world.
examples: Rain fell through the open roof of the Roman villa's atrium into the shallow pool, and the slaves moved softly over the mosaic floor between the painted walls.
The master of the villa received his clients by the fountain in the peristyle, a cup of wine in his hand and the frescoed walls bright behind him.

scenes.name: Amphitheatre
scenes.description: The arena of a great Roman amphitheatre, tiers of stone seating rising all round a floor of raked sand, arches in rows, awnings stretched over the upper rim and gates in the arena wall below. Brutal, spectacular, roaring. Suits gladiators and the games, a crowd deciding a fate, emperors in their box, and death as entertainment.
examples: The gladiators came out onto the sand of the arena, and the whole amphitheatre rose around them in a roar that shook the stone.
From the emperor's box the colosseum was a bowl of fifty thousand faces, and on the sand of the arena below a gladiator with a net circled a man with a sword.

scenes.name: Castle Courtyard
scenes.description: The inner courtyard of a medieval castle, high curtain walls and towers of grey stone on every side, a well and a smithy against one wall, wooden stairs up to the keep and a gatehouse with its portcullis raised. Fortified, busy, martial. Suits knights and squires, a lord's household, arrivals through the gatehouse, and a siege waiting to happen.
examples: Knights clattered into the castle bailey under the raised portcullis, and squires ran to take their horses while the banners snapped on the towers.
In the courtyard of the castle a boy drew water from the well, and the blacksmith's hammer rang against the curtain wall in the cold morning.

scenes.name: Great Hall Feast
scenes.description: The great hall of a medieval castle at a feast, long trestle tables laden with roasts and candles, a high table on a dais under heraldic banners and tapestries, a fire roaring in a huge stone fireplace set in the wall and minstrels playing in a gallery above. Festive, loud, political. Suits a lord's feast, knights and ladies, oaths and toasts, a poisoned cup, and a wedding that ends in blood.
examples: The castle's great hall was loud with the feast, the trestle tables laden with roasts and candles, and at the high table the lord raised his goblet to the bride.
Minstrels played in the gallery above the banquet hall, heraldic banners hung from the rafters, and the knights drank toast after toast before the great fireplace.

scenes.name: Blacksmith's Forge
scenes.description: A blacksmith's forge in a village, the fire glowing orange in a stone hearth under a hood, an anvil on a stump, tongs and hammers hanging from the beams, a quenching trough and sparks in the smoky dark. Hot, rhythmic, honest. Suits a smith and an apprentice, a sword being made, village life, and a hero's humble beginnings.
examples: In the forge the blacksmith drew the glowing iron from the fire with his tongs and laid it on the anvil, and the hammer rang out across the village.
The apprentice worked the bellows until the coals roared white, and sparks flew up into the smoky rafters of the smithy.

scenes.name: Space Station Corridor
scenes.description: A curving corridor aboard an orbiting space station, white panels lit from within, handrails and hatches along the walls, and a wide viewport showing the curve of a blue planet turning slowly below. Clean, sealed, lonely. Suits astronauts and crews, life in orbit, a malfunction or an intruder, and home seen from very far away.
examples: The corridor of the space station curved away ahead, white panels lit from within, and through the viewport the planet turned slowly below.
The astronaut pulled herself along the handrails to the airlock, the hatch sealed behind her, and their orbit carried them on into night.

scenes.name: Alien World
scenes.description: The surface of an alien planet, a plain of strange rock and pale sand under a violet sky, two moons low on the horizon, and towering mineral spires rising in the distance. Awe-struck, hostile, unknown. Suits first contact, a crash landing, explorers far from Earth, and a world that was never meant for us.
examples: They stepped down from the lander onto the alien world, violet sky above and two moons low over a plain of strange rock and pale sand.
The explorer climbed to the lip of the crater in her spacesuit, and below her the spires of the alien planet rose out of the dust like a city.

scenes.name: Academy of Magic
scenes.description: The dining hall of an old academy of magic in a mountain fortress, long wooden tables under a high vaulted ceiling, tall arched windows full of evening light, stacks of spellbooks and lanterns burning with a cold blue flame. Wondrous, scholarly, full of secrets. Suits young mages at school, lessons in spells, friendships and rivalries, and a mystery in the corridors.
examples: The apprentices ate at the long tables of the academy's dining hall, spellbooks open beside their plates and blue flames flickering in the lanterns overhead.
In the school of magic the old wizard raised his hand, and every candle in the vaulted hall went out at once while the young mages held their breath.

scenes.name: Dragon's Lair
scenes.description: A vast cavern deep under a mountain, heaps of gold coins, goblets and armour spilling across the rock floor, a sleeping dragon's coils half seen in shadow and a thin shaft of light falling from a crack far above. Awesome, deadly, greedy. Suits a quest's end, treasure and the price of it, a thief creeping in, and a battle with a monster.
examples: The dragon slept on its hoard in the depths of the lair, gold coins and goblets heaped around its coils, and smoke rose from its nostrils with every breath.
The thief crept down into the treasure chamber by the thin shaft of light, and the mountain of gold before him shifted and began to breathe.

scenes.name: Lagos Market
scenes.description: A vast open-air market in Lagos, narrow lanes between stalls under coloured umbrellas and tin roofs, heaps of peppers, fabrics and plastic goods, yellow buses at the edge and the heat hanging over everything. Loud, crowded, alive. Suits market traders and hustlers, family business, a chase through the stalls, and the energy of a West African city.
examples: The market in Lagos went on for miles, stall after stall under coloured umbrellas, traders shouting prices over heaps of peppers and bolts of bright fabric.
She pushed through the Lagos market past the yellow danfo buses, haggling at a stall for a bolt of ankara cloth while the heat pressed down on the tin roofs.

scenes.name: Mexico City Street
scenes.description: A street in the old centre of Mexico City, colonial buildings painted ochre, pink and blue with iron balconies, jacaranda trees in purple flower, a taco stand under a striped awning and the dome of a church at the end. Colourful, lively, layered with history. Suits Mexican stories, family and politics, a meal from a street stall, and a city of saints and revolutions.
examples: The street in Mexico City was purple with jacaranda blossom, the colonial houses painted ochre and pink, and the taco stand on the corner was already smoking.
A mariachi band played under the iron balconies of the old colonial street in Mexico City, and the church bells answered from the dome at the end of it.

scenes.name: Bosphorus Ferry
scenes.description: The deck of a ferry crossing the Bosphorus in Istanbul, gulls hanging over the wake, the domes and minarets of the old city on one shore and wooden waterfront mansions on the other, tea glasses on the rail. Romantic, crossing between worlds, melancholy. Suits Istanbul stories, commuting between continents, a conversation over tea on the water, and memory and loss.
examples: The ferry crossed the Bosphorus in the grey afternoon, gulls hanging over the wake, and the minarets of Istanbul rose above the water on the far shore.
She drank her tea at the rail of the deck, Europe on one side and Asia on the other, and threw the end of her simit to the gulls.

scenes.name: Cairo Rooftops
scenes.description: The rooftops of old Cairo at sunset, a jumble of flat roofs with satellite dishes, water tanks and pigeon coops, minarets rising all around and the haze of the great city stretching to the pyramids on the horizon. Crowded, ancient, golden with dust. Suits Egyptian stories, family life above the street, the call to prayer, and a city of a thousand minarets.
examples: From the rooftops of Cairo the minarets rose on every side into the dusty gold of sunset, and the call to prayer began from one and then from all of them.
He kept pigeons in a coop on his Cairo rooftop, among the satellite dishes and the laundry, and on clear evenings he could see the pyramids from there.

scenes.name: Moroccan Riad
scenes.description: The courtyard of a Moroccan riad, a tiled fountain in the middle surrounded by orange trees, carved plaster arches and painted cedar doors on every side, galleries above and a square of blue sky over it all. Cool, secluded, serene. Suits North African stories, a family house hidden behind a plain wall, mint tea in the afternoon, and secrets kept from the street.
examples: The riad was a Moroccan house turned inward, its rooms opening onto a tiled courtyard with a fountain and orange trees, and no window at all on the street of the medina.
In the riad's courtyard in Marrakech they sat on cushions drinking mint tea by the fountain, under carved arches and the painted cedar doors of the upper gallery.

scenes.name: Country House Drawing Room
scenes.description: The drawing room of an English country house in the afternoon, tall windows onto a lawn and parkland, sofas and armchairs round a marble fireplace, portraits on the walls, a piano and a tea tray on a low table. Genteel, mannered, full of undercurrents. Suits families and inheritances, courtship and marriage, visitors and scandal, and life in the great houses.
examples: Tea was brought into the drawing room, and she sat very straight on the sofa by the fireplace while the portraits of his ancestors looked down on her.
The butler announced the visitor, and in the long drawing room of the country house every conversation stopped at once.
